title: Java Quiz - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Java quizzes are one of the best ways to improve coding and problem-solving skills through regular practice. These chapter-wise quizzes help learners test their understanding of individual Java concepts with short and focused questions. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced developer, these quizzes help strengthen your Java knowledge and identify areas for improvement.

  • Chapter-wise quizzes for focused learning
  • Helps improve Java concepts and logical thinking
  • No registration required to start practicing

Basics Fundamentals

  • Basics and Identifier
  • Variables
  • Operator
  • Control Statements and Loops

Core Programming (Methods, Arrays, string)

  • Methods
  • Arrays
  • Array Class
  • String Basics
  • String Classes

OOP Concepts

  • Classes and Objects
  • Constructors
  • Inheritance and Abstraction
  • Polymorphism and Packages
  • Interfaces
  • Interface types and Comparator

Exception Handling & Regex

  • Exceptions
  • Exception Handling
  • Regex Basics and Pattern Matching

Memory & JVM

  • Memory Allocation
  • Heap vs Stack
  • JVM Memory Management and Garbage Collection

Collections Framework

  • Collection
  • List
  • ArrayList
  • LinkedList
  • Set and HashSet
  • Queue and Map Interface
  • Iterators
  • Comparator vs Comparable

Multithreading & Synchronization

  • Thread Basics and Lifecycle
  • Thread Methods and Daemon Threads
  • Synchronization Basics
  • Deadlocks and Synchronization

Functional Programming & File Handling

  • File Handling
  • File Writing
  • Lambda Expressions and Streams.

Networking & Database Connectivity

  • Networking Basics and Protocols
  • Sockets and Server Communication
  • JDBC
